lines: - Backend-Batch 5 (3 Dateien, alle voll gelesen, nur Huellen + `TALK TO THE HAND`): `vps_container_lifecycle` (Create/Delete/Start/Stop/Restart, Stats, User-Instanzen, Config-Update mit Rollback), `vps_health_monitoring` (Clone/Migrate, Ping-/Port-/Process-/API-Checks mit Allow-Listen, Benchmarks, History/Netz-Stats), `vps_instance_persistence` (Postgres-primaer/JSON-Fallback mit Lock, DB-CRUD, SSH-Command).
